name: Mayrhofen
kurzbeschreibung: The heart of the Zillertal – famous for its legendary snowboarding event and breathtaking hiking trails in summer.
beschreibung:
Mayrhofen is nestled at an elevation of 630 meters in the upper Zillertal valley in the Schwaz district. With around 3,800 residents, it is the vibrant heart of the valley. Arriving aboard the historic narrow-gauge Zillertal Railway, travelers reach the town directly on the valley floor – framed dramatically by Mount Penken to the south and Mount Ahorn to the north.

In winter, Mayrhofen garners international acclaim: winter sports enthusiasts flock to the world-class terrain on Mount Penken, home to the infamous 'Harakiri' run with a steep gradient of up to 78 percent. The Ahornbahn cable car whisks guests up to 1,950 meters, accessing family-friendly ski slopes in winter and an expansive hiking arena in summer, complete with the panoramic Ahornbahn Skywalk. More than 200 kilometers of marked trails lead into the Zillertal Alps Nature Park, leading up to the legendary Berliner Hütte or around the high-altitude Schlegeis reservoir at 1,800 meters.

In the evenings, guests gather in cozy inns and traditional taverns to relish authentic Zillertal specialties: crispy Kaspressknödel, savory Zillertaler Krapfen, and spicy Graukäse. Mayrhofen effortlessly unites alpine authenticity, world-class events, and immediate access to pristine mountain nature.
